parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
- Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the gateway endpoint to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The name of the endpoint service to query.
